reason: My walls are not peeling and there is no function coming up, so I would not book a repaint this month just because I saw an ad. Also, I live in a flat in Kakkanad, so the outside is the association's job and I do not want to pay a package price that includes exterior work I cannot use.
objection: These crews start, then vanish for a week to another site. My building only lets contractors in during fixed hours, so I doubt they can really finish on the date they promise, and the ad says nothing about what happens to me if they miss it.
would_change_my_mind: A written finish date with money back for every day they run late, a crew that confirms it will work within my building's contractor hours, and a lower interior-only price for a flat.
